A weeknight recipe from Málaga.

> [!TIP]
> Use **fresh** basil.

## Ingredients

### For the sauce

- 2 cups *tomatoes*
- 1 tsp salt

## Steps

1. Boil water for 10 minutes.
2. Toss with the sauce.

> [!WARNING]
> ```quiz
> When do you add the basil?
> - [ ] Before boiling
> - [x] At the end
> ```

## Notes

Keeps 3 days.
